verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch ships an official MCP server that exposes collections, requests, environments, and teams to an AI agent for reading/modifying, and this handshake is verified hands-on — enabling natural-language operation via an AI agent client. However, there's no evidence of a built-in natural-language command interface within Hoppscotch's own UI/CLI itself; the capability depends entirely on pairing with an external agent. Missing for 10: first-party in-app NL command palette/assistant, documentation of specific NL use-case examples, independent community validation of agentic workflows via the MCP server.
